## Release impact

- [ ] This changes the distributed package (including packaged consumer documentation), and the PR includes a changeset.
- [ ] This changes only internal files, so no changeset is needed.

For an AimHarder authentication or API-interpretation change, link the applicable authorized local live check before merging. See [the release procedure](https://github.com/rudeayelo/aimharder-mcp/blob/main/docs/releasing.md).
